config:
# MLX-LM LoRA config for apkscan-local v2: short prompt, decision-weighted loss (train/train_weighted.py) (Apple M4, 16 GB).
model: models/base/Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct
train: true
data: data/processed
fine_tune_type: lora
optimizer: adamw
mask_prompt: true          # loss only on the assistant JSON
num_layers: 16             # LoRA on the last 16 of 28 blocks
batch_size: 2
grad_accumulation_steps: 1
iters: 600                 # about 1.5 epochs over 780 records (batch 2); batch 4 stalled in swap on 16 GB
learning_rate: 1.5e-4
lr_schedule:
  name: linear_schedule   # warmup then constant 1.5e-4 (v1 decayed to 1e-6 and under-trained the decision)
  warmup: 30
  arguments: [1.5e-4, 1.5e-4, 600]
max_seq_length: 2304
grad_checkpoint: true
steps_per_report: 10
steps_per_eval: 100
val_batches: 20
save_every: 100
adapter_path: models/adapters/v2
seed: 0
lora_parameters:
  keys: ["self_attn.q_proj", "self_attn.k_proj", "self_attn.v_proj", "self_attn.o_proj", "mlp.gate_proj", "mlp.up_proj", "mlp.down_proj"]
  rank: 16
  scale: 2.0
  dropout: 0.05
